extraction_summary: This 10-K (FY2021, filed 2022-03-31) discloses ZERO J-Book-grounded claims. AST SpaceMobile at this point is exclusively a commercial space-based cellular play partnering with mobile network operators (MNOs) — no DoD/Pentagon program exposure, no PE numbers, no named DoD programs, no government contracts, no defense customers. The 'AST Defense' subsidiary referenced in cohort metadata is NOT mentioned anywhere in this filing. The J-Book divergence pattern therefore has no discriminative signal on this filing at this PIT. Control claims (commercial pipeline, facilities, MNO counterparties, BW3) are extracted instead so the framework can still verify orthogonal claims.
